facts.fact: The AI Unit of the Ministry of ICT and Innovation says its website is working to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA and is not yet fully there.

The AI Unit's government website offers built-in accessibility tools including read-aloud, text scaling from 80% to 200%, high contrast, a dyslexia-friendly font, keyboard navigation and a simple language mode.
The AI Unit states it fixed all critical issues found in its May 2026 accessibility audit of its website, and that some Framework Library PDFs may still not read correctly in a screen reader.
